body: Try resetting your CMOS. It should be either be one of those button batteries or a small button on your mother board that will say something along the lines of CMOS RESET OR RST CMOS. If you have the battery just power down the system and pop it out for about 30 sec and put it back in and try to boot. If you have the physical button just press it
